title: 第12章 你脸皮用砂纸磨的？
slug: 酒店亲错人京圈大佬他白天嫌弃晚上疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

温以染还没想好怎么编，傅临渊已经掀开被子下床，捡起地上的衬衫慢条斯理地穿上。

“九点准时到楼下。”他走到门口，回头看她，“别迟到。”

温以染撑起身子：“先别走。”

傅临渊停住，侧脸线条冷硬。

“傅先生，结一下账。”温以染伸出两根手指，比了个数钱的动作，“别忘了加班费。”

傅临渊冷笑，从裤袋里摸出手机，指尖点了两下。

温以染手机震了，到账提示：六十万。

她心满意足地笑了：“谢谢老板，老板慢走。”

傅临渊摔门而去。

温以染起床洗漱。

和风会所。

沈惊鸿坐在真皮沙发上，捏着酒杯不放心地问：“哥，你确定这个办法有用？”

沈知豪笑着给她添了酒，语气笃定：“放心，傅临渊不过是图个新鲜。温以染这种女人，他几天不见就忘了。”

他放下酒瓶，语气得意：“你上次让我想办法，所以我特意安排她去江城，就是为了让她先消失一阵子。”

“傅临渊什么人？这种女人几天不见就忘干净了，等回来了还有她什么事？”

沈惊鸿咬唇，仍不甘心：“可我还是觉得不踏实……”

“什么不踏实？你这是自寻烦恼。”

沈知豪嗤笑一声：“温以染算什么东西，也配跟你比？她不过是牧野的一个玩具，连正经女朋友都不算。

傅临渊就算感兴趣，也就是玩玩，你还真当他上心？”

沈惊鸿想起温以染那张脸，恨意涌上来：“那要是临渊忘不了呢？”

“忘不了？”沈知豪像是听到了天大的笑话，“傅临渊那种身份，碰她都是自降身价。”

“你以为傅家会允许？等老爷子知道，不用你出手，傅临渊自己就得把她扔了。”

沈惊鸿终于露出笑容，举起酒杯：“哥，还是你想得周到。”

温以染在酒店自助餐吃完早餐，化好妆，九点准时到了楼下。

孟群替温以染

坐上车，温以染问傅临渊：“傅先生，这几天我的工作内容是什么？”

傅临渊目光从平板移到她的脸上，“温小姐除了会伺候男人，还会什么？”

“吱——”

一个急刹车，车子蓦地停住。

后排的两个人身子跟着晃了晃。

岳群心里呼了一口气，好险，差点闯了红灯。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Before Wen Yiran could figure out how to knit it, Fu Linyuan had already lifted the quilt and got out of bed, picked up the shirt on the floor and put it on slowly.

"Be downstairs at nine o'clock on time." He walked to the door and looked back at her, "Don't be late."

Wen Yiran propped himself up: "Don't leave yet."

Fu Linyuan stopped, his face profile cold and hard.

"Mr. Fu, please settle the bill." Wen Yiran stretched out two fingers as if counting money, "Don't forget the overtime pay."

Fu Linyuan sneered, took out his cell phone from his trouser pocket, and tapped it twice with his fingertips.

Wen Yiran's phone vibrated, and it showed a message saying: 600,000.

She smiled contentedly: "Thank you, boss. Take your time, boss."

Fu Linyuan slammed the door and left.

Wen Yiran got up and washed up.

Japanese style club.

Shen Jinghong sat on the leather sofa, holding the wine glass and asked worriedly: "Brother, are you sure this method will work?"

Shen Zhihao smiled and gave her more wine, and said in a firm tone: "Don't worry, Fu Linyuan is just trying to make something new. He will forget about a woman like Wen Yiran after a few days."

He put down the bottle and said in a proud tone: "You asked me to find a way last time, so I specially arranged for her to go to Jiangcheng just to make her disappear for a while."

"Who is Fu Linyuan? This kind of woman forgets everything after not seeing her for a few days. What will happen to her when she comes back?"

Shen Jinghong bit his lip, still unwilling to give in: "But I still feel uneasy..."

"What's wrong with you? You're asking for trouble."

Shen Zhihao sneered: "Who does Wen Yiran deserve to be compared with you? She is just a toy of Makino, not even a serious girlfriend.

Even if Fu Linyuan is interested, just for fun, do you really think he is interested?"

Shen Jinghong thought of Wen Yiran's face, and hatred came to him: "What if Linyuan can't forget it?"

"Can't you forget?" Shen Zhihao seemed to have heard a big joke, "With Fu Linyuan's status, if you touch her, you will be devalued."

"Do you think the Fu family will allow it? When the old man finds out, Fu Linyuan will have to throw her away without you taking action."

Shen Jinghong finally smiled and raised his glass: "Brother, you are still thoughtful."

Wen Yiran finished breakfast at the hotel buffet, put on makeup, and arrived downstairs at nine o'clock on time.

Meng Qun replaced Wen Yiran

After getting in the car, Wen Yiran asked Fu Linyuan: "Mr. Fu, what is my work content these days?"

Fu Linyuan's eyes moved from the tablet to her face, "In addition to serving men, what else can Miss Wen do?"

"Squeak——"

A sudden brake and the car suddenly stopped.

The two people in the back row swayed.

Yue Qun breathed a sigh of relief. It was so dangerous that he almost ran a red light.
